The independent [parent probability/quantum screen](iterations/i07-parent-probability-screen.md) rejects two already-covered targets and a false quantum-memory extension. It derives a weighted necessary capacity condition for variable-edge four-state reconstruction and an exact counterexample to the naive unweighted extension. Iteration 08 now supplies a proposed converse, described below; the completed reviews now support R009 below.

The [arithmetic report](iterations/i07-arithmetic.md) is integrated with 38 verified pinned sources and 62 verified artifacts. Exact checks reproduce the inverse complex phase and enlarged quartic cell. The report proves ordinary-integer main-term expansions but leaves the marked prime-extraction estimate CM unproved; prime-input quartic squarefreeness and full consecutive-integer PD are demoted as routine consequences of lower-level source interfaces. The completed [iteration 10 candidate](iterations/i10-complex-prime-modes.md) now proposes a common physical principal model, a separate high-time estimate, a summed presieve estimate and exact aggregate recombination. Its new joint Omega modulo m / PD theorem now passes the [independent proof audit](reviews/i10-complex-prime-modes-r2.md), with [four integration clarifications](iterations/i10-complex-modes-proof-integration.md). Parent reproduction verifies every finite diagnostic, 90 unchanged inputs, 30 review artifacts, and 38 prior, 11 candidate and 14 fresh pinned sources. The completed [final significance review](reviews/i10-complex-modes-novelty-r3.md) recommends ACCEPT as a nonroutine common-principal-model construction. Parent checks reproduce and verify 101 artifacts, 158 dependencies and 36 fresh pinned files. The result is accepted as [R010](findings/R010-complex-modes-PD-independence.md), the fourth substantial finding. Worldwide priority remains unverified.

The [structural report](iterations/i07-structures.md) proves a proposed arbitrary-rank family of individually unrealizable outer involutions on closed aspherical four-manifolds. Its [proof audit](reviews/i07-structures-r2.md) passes, but the completed [significance audit](reviews/i07-structures-novelty-r3.md) recommends **technical only**. The height lemma reduces to the source's cyclic-cover criterion, and detectors in all nonzero binary directions give the rank conclusion by finite replication. The stronger exact cover classification retains useful content, but its signed-graph mechanism does not meet the requested nonroutine gate. No literal literature duplicate or counterexample is claimed. Parent reproduction passes 6,024 skew-lattice checks, 1,036,416 binary-direction checks, 1,302 coset checks, and the 31-artifact/274-dependency seal. The independent proof PASS is retained; the accepted count remains three.
## Iteration 08: capacity accepted as R009

[The weighted-capacity theorem](findings/R009-variable-channel-capacity.md) covers arbitrary positive edge-channel parameters up to and including perfect transmission. Its uniform local moment estimate and flow-splitting energy bound replace the fixed-channel geometric bound. The [independent proof audit](reviews/i08-variable-capacity-r2.md) and [final prior-art/significance audit](reviews/i08-variable-capacity-novelty-r3.md) pass. The parent read both reports, reproduced the checks and verified source/artifact identities. The significance audit covers 41 pinned sources, 11 primary PDFs and 101 sealed artifacts. No worldwide-priority claim follows.
## Iteration 11: accepted strengthening within R009

The [locally finite extension](iterations/i11-locally-finite-capacity.md) and universal information bounds pass the [round-4 proof audit](reviews/i11-locally-finite-capacity-r4.md), with parent reproduction of all 17 artifacts and five source identities. The direct proof iterates binary subadditivity of `g(m)=m+m^3/3000`. Zero-channel pruning is jointly independent; an infinitely branching finite-chain example shows local finiteness is essential. The reviewer also supplies a perfect-copy binary-gadget reduction of qualitative reconstruction to the new bounded-child theorem. This is part of R009, never an additional count. Original candidate files retain their historical status text; R009 and this ledger govern acceptance.

## I38 accepted as R012; sixth substantial finding

The [final R3 review](reviews/i38-propeller-stability-novelty-r3.md) recommends **SUBSTANTIAL**, preserving R2's **original-proof PASS without repairs**. The parent accepts [R012 — uniform Gaussian propeller stability](findings/R012-uniform-gaussian-propeller-stability.md) as the **sixth substantial finding**. Its one positive constant is independent of ambient dimension, finite label count and cell masses; the distance exponent 1/2 is sharp. The implicit constant is not claimed effective or optimal. All mass-concentration consequences count as this same result.

The acceptance record preserves the full theorem, source dependencies, proof outline, constants, review decisions and novelty limits. The result is not described as the first quantitative propeller theorem or a sharp-constant theorem. [I39 quantum/spectral discovery](iterations/iteration39-quantum-spectral-discovery-task.json) now screens fresh area-law, Haldane and spin-glass/spectral consequences, requiring a substantive new mechanism rather than routine gap or compactness transfers. The ten-finding objective remains active: **six accepted, four remaining**.

The [completed I39 report](iterations/i39-quantum-spectral-discovery.md) is a **developed gap record**, with no substantial nomination. Its selected target H asks for a positive gap uniform over every sufficiently small scalar bond-disorder profile on all sufficiently long even spin-one Heisenberg rings. Both a disordered transfer/purity route and a local-energy/dressing route leave H **unproved and not refuted**.

The parent read the full report and verifier, checked the Gaussian warming statement and the opening strong-semigroup/weak-density interfaces in the quench source, and reproduced [both commands](experiments/i39-parent-verification.json). Checks pass for 258 sealed artifacts, 163 frozen inputs, 159 selected source files in ten manuscripts, 28 successful responses including eight fresh identical pinned responses, ten versioned primary papers, 34 read records and 389 exact assertions. All 9,340 corpus files match the complete 749-manuscript inventory; the project screen covers 158 Markdown files. Two mutable ledger changes and the previously recorded removal of one trailing newline from R012 remain explicitly separated from proof dependencies. The diagnostics are exact finite checks, not independent analytic acceptance of the new partial deductions.
